steps.note: Coffee cream of 10 to 18 % fat is made by mixing 40 % cream with skim milk to the wanted fat.
Cream is homogenised at 10 to 20 MPa while the fat is still liquid, above 35 °C, so it does not feather in coffee.
Coffee cream is heated to 85 to 95 °C for up to 15 to 20 seconds.
It is then cooled to about 5 °C.
